# hivenet_images (Data Source)

Lists the images of one type that the account can launch, for `image_type` and `image_id` on `hivenet_instance`. VM images are left out when no location the account can use allows their OS family. Windows images are listed but cannot be created through the API yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Ubuntu VM images that boot on a GPU preset.
data "hivenet_images" "ubuntu_gpu" {
  type          = "vm"
  name_regex    = "^Ubuntu"
  gpu_supported = true
}

# Container templates you saved in the console.
data "hivenet_images" "my_templates" {
  type = "container"
  mine = true
}

output "ubuntu_gpu_image_ids" {
  value = data.hivenet_images.ubuntu_gpu.images[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) `vm` or `container`.

### Optional

- `gpu_supported` (Boolean) Only VM images that can (`true`) or cannot (`false`) boot on a GPU preset. Only with `type = "vm"`.
- `mine` (Boolean) List the container templates you saved instead of the Hivenet catalogue. Only with `type = "container"`. A teammate's templates are never listed.
- `name_regex` (String) Only images whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), e.g. `^Ubuntu`.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) Matching images, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `command` (String) Command the container runs. Empty means the image's own. Container images only; null for VMs.
- `created_at` (String) When the template was saved (RFC 3339). Null when not known. Container images only; null for VMs.
- `gpu_supported` (Boolean) Whether the image can boot on a GPU preset. VM images only; null for containers.
- `id` (String) Image ID, used as `image_id` when creating an instance, e.g. `ubuntu24.04`.
- `image` (String) Image reference, e.g. `jupyter/base-notebook:latest`. Container images only; null for VMs.
- `login_user` (String) The account a Linux image creates for you to log in with, e.g. `ubuntu`. Empty when not known, and always for Windows. VM images only; null for containers.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Smallest preset storage the image boots with, in GB. `0` means no minimum. VM images only; null for containers.
- `min_memory_gb` (Number) Smallest preset memory the image boots with, in GB. `0` means no minimum. VM images only; null for containers.
- `name` (String) Display name, e.g. `Ubuntu 24.04 LTS`.
- `os_family` (String) `LINUX`, `WINDOWS` or `UNSPECIFIED`. Read any other value as unknown. VM images only; null for containers.
- `registry` (String) Registry the image is pulled from, e.g. `docker.io`. Container images only; null for VMs.
- `secure_boot` (Boolean) Whether instances boot with UEFI Secure Boot. VM images only; null for containers.
- `software_list` (List of String) Software the template ships, e.g. `["python", "jupyter"]`. Container images only; null for VMs.
- `tpm` (Boolean) Whether instances get a virtual TPM. VM images only; null for containers.
- `type` (String) `vm` or `container`.
- `workload_type` (String) `CPU`, `GPU` or `UNSPECIFIED`. Read any other value as unknown. Container images only; null for VMs.
